preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ ()' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only letters (a-z, A-Z), spaces, and parentheses '()'

postconditions.expression: not any('(' in output_string or ')' in output_string)
postconditions.description: The output string contains no parentheses

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ ' for c in output_string)
postconditions.description: The output string contains only letters and spaces

postconditions.expression: len(output_string) == len([c for c in input_string if c not in '()'])
postconditions.description: The output string is exactly the input string with all parentheses and their contents removed
